notes.title: New DLC - EX MISSION: VS Ziyan F&M Now Live!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce that the first DLC for Virtua Unlimited Project, "EX MISSION VS Ziyan F&M," is now officially live! This time, we're bringing you an unprecedented challenge—the first-ever dual-BOSS fight, along with a mysterious hidden BOSS in a secret level. Additionally, we've introduced a color-changing system, allowing players to further personalize their gaming experience.

[b]BOSS Introduction: Ziyan F & Ziyan M[/b]
The carefully crafted dual BOSSes, the Ziyan Sisters, will present you with an entirely new challenge. Not only do they possess unique combat techniques, but they also deliver an unparalleled battle experience.

[b]BOSS Details:[/b]
The Ziyan Sisters were once part of the legendary mercenary team, the Pro Operators. With years of combat experience, they excelled in team operations involving anywhere from 4 to 24 people. As veterans of the mercenary world, they have become mentors to the next generation of mercenaries.
The knowledge and tactics they developed throughout their careers have become industry standards. At the peak of their mercenary careers, they suddenly announced their retirement and disappeared from the public eye, leaving behind countless legends.
The reasons for their retirement remain a hot topic of speculation among mercenaries.

[b]V-tuber Collab: Ziyan[/b]
We are also incredibly honored to collaborate with the popular virtual streamer Ziyan. To learn more about her, please visit her Bilibili page here: [url=https://space.bilibili.com/293917]子言姐姐[/url] 

We greatly appreciate the support and love from all our players and hope you enjoy the new content. Start the game now to experience this exciting new adventure!

Stay tuned for more thrilling content!

Having trouble with the game? Contact us on social media or join our Discord community for help!

Virtua Unlimited Project: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934030/

notes.title: "VIRTUA UNLIMITED PROJECT" Version 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, players!

"Virtua Unlimited Project" has been on sale for nearly two months now. During these two months, the production team has been continuously receiving feedback from you, the players, and performing maintenance.
In addition to this, we have also been updating the game's content.

1. [New] Added EX·Boss Rush to the training machine, where you challenge all bosses in succession; dying midway ends the attempt (Note: In this mode, there will be no restoration of health and support value between DG's first and second phases).
2. [New] Added a portrait painting gallery to Leonid Castle, and all portrait painting enemies within the level will become random portraits.
3. [New] Added achievements related to Boss Rush and the portrait painting gallery.
4. [BUG]Fixed issues with the progress bar and looping for some tracks in the original soundtrack system.
5. [New] Added several pieces of fanart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42122267/212f7e8b2d7b410b0d7d86275fcd058f774bb358.png[/img]

Thank you all for your support of "Virtua Unlimited Project" We will continue to work hard to produce even better content!

notes.notes:
Today's Boss - Memo ，Every boss has its counterpart as a Vtuber in real life

Boss Name：Memo

Boss Introduction：
A Pro operator living in a huge aerial facility, relying on devices to sustain life. Her unique way of speaking is to cope with the side effects of her abilities. Her actual age seems to differ from her appearance. In the battle with Kana, she continuously used a variety of complex wind attribute techniques, but for her, it was just a 'game.

notes.title: Boss Intro - ICE
notes.notes:
Today's Boss - ICE ，Every boss has its counterpart as a Vtuber in real life

Boss Name：ICE

Boss Introduction：
A professor in the 'Operator Academy' University Division's Magic Department and a Pro operator. A leading figure in the Magic Department and the Pro operator with the most authority on ice magic at the current stage. A witness to the Pompeii Incident 20 years ago. As a more traditional operator, she doesn't rely heavily on devices to construct techniques. Her hobbies include painting, sculpting, and art appreciation. Her carving skills are so advanced that her ice sculptures can be mistaken for real objects.

Vtuber：[url=https://space.bilibili.com/411861391]ICE_氷[/url](Click to view)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42122267/76344752f562fd9369e03381752704daa4525ab3.png[/img]

notes.title: Boss Intro - Eliana
notes.notes:
Today's Boss - Eliana ，Every boss has its counterpart as a Vtuber in real life

Boss Name：Eliana

Boss Introduction：
The current head of the 'Leonid Knight Family,' a non-material cultural heritage, and a 'knight' who miraculously exists in an era where she shouldn't. A Pro operator with years of combat experience, her family made significant contributions during the Pompeii Incident 20 years ago. She doesn't have a strong awareness of being a 'knight,' and her behavior is no different from that of ordinary women her age. However, in critical moments, you will witness what true knightly spirit is from her.

Vtuber：[url=https://space.bilibili.com/873389]莉娅Eliana[/url] (Click to view)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42122267/de61668b90161913a3d3fb1243a65173414ff7ba.png[/img]

notes.title: Boss Intro - Yan
notes.notes:
Today's Boss - Yan ，Every boss has its counterpart as a Vtuber in real life

Boss Name：Yan

Boss Introduction：
A geological expert in the 'Operator Academy' University Division, the last disciple of Professor ICE of the Magic Department, and a Pro operator. With 2 years of combat experience, she was the top student in the 'Magic Department' during her time in the high school division. She uses a variety of devices to construct techniques for combat. Her hobbies include traveling, adventuring, exploring ruins, collecting books, and visual materials. She is a Pro operator who longs for and has the ability to live a free life.

Vtuber：[url=https://space.bilibili.com/7326570]燕逐晓[/url](Click to view)

notes.title: Boss Intro - Shiroi Hana
notes.notes:
Today's Boss - Shiroi Hana ，Every boss has its counterpart as a Vtuber in real life

Boss Name：Shiroi Hana

Boss Introduction：
A junior at the 'Operator Academy' High School Division, majoring in Information Management. She is the captain of the kendo club and a member of the discipline committee. With less than a year of combat experience, she excels in sword fighting. Her current sword is named 'Koujin.' Popular in the academy for her cute appearance, she is respected by her peers for her flexible approach as a discipline committee member. She has a close relationship with Kana Aizawa at the academy and is seen as cute and well-behaved by others.
